Subject: FoundersSlate sandbox allowance for cohort onboarding

Hi Naomi —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We moved FoundersSlate into the next phase of cohort acceptance and need a small sandbox allowance to get our teams integrated before the cohort start (roughly 6–8 devs for 3 weeks).

Quick Qs before I put together the formal request:
- What is the minimum commit or usage profile you need to qualify for a temporary sandbox allowance?
- Do you have a standard term sheet or is this usually handled as a one-off pilot agreement?
- Any security artifacts (SOC 2 excerpt, retention guarantees) we should expect to share?

We’d like to have credits applied by May 18 so our engineers can begin smoke testing. If it helps, Tom Rivers (cc’d) is our ops lead and can coordinate SSO/KMS questions.

Best,
Anya

Subject: Re: FoundersSlate sandbox allowance for cohort onboarding

Hi Anya —

Great to hear about the cohort. Short answers up front:
- Minimum qualifying profile: light usage baseline (approx 50k tokens total over 3 weeks) OR a signed pilot commitment from the program confirming cohort size and a nominal billing card on file.
- Term sheet: we have a short pilot credit term sheet we use for accelerator partners. I can share a draft.
- Security artifacts: we can provide SOC 2 excerpt and our data handling summary; for SSO/KMS we’ll need your IdP metadata and an SCIM provisioning contact.

Can you send the IdP details and confirm whether you’ll accept a conditional credit (credits applied pending a short signed pilot sheet)? If yes, I’ll route this for a quick approval and get the term sheet over.

I’ve cc’d Jordan who helps onboard cohort integrations and can assist with the technical checklist.

Thanks —
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Partnerships, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

Looks fine to me — approve conditional credit up to $7,500 with the following controls:
- Credits expire after 30 days if pilot term not signed.
- Usage limits: single-tenant bandwidth cap and token alert at 60% of allocation.
- Require signed pilot-credit-term-sheet and billing contact on file before credits applied.

Attaching the term sheet I usually send to programs.

Hi Anya —

Thanks — we can approve a conditional sandbox allowance of up to $7,500 in credits. Next steps to get credits applied:
1) Please review and sign the attached pilot-credit-term-sheet (I’ve attached a DocuSign link below).
2) Share IdP metadata or let us know if you want to use temporary API keys for the integration test.
3) Provide a billing contact (name + card) to hold the account — we won’t charge unless usage exceeds the credit or the pilot proceeds to a paid commitment.

Once we receive the signed sheet and billing contact we’ll apply credits (expected within 24 hours). If you need an earlier window, tell us the exact engineers and we can whitelist test IPs to speed the onboarding.
